data.narrative:
Swan is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Dima Kislovskiy and Narek Melik Barkhudarov that has raised $38.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies across the sector (2 public, 8 private), including same-stage and adjacent-stage peers such as UFORCE, Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods anchor the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, using the $38.5M raised as a proxy baseline, yielding $96M. Peer-median analysis across the 5 most relevant comparables—spanning valuations from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence)—produces a $1.0B median. This wide range reflects heterogeneity in stage progression within the peer set, with three Series A companies and one Seed-stage company (UFORCE at $1.0B) anchoring the distribution.

Triangulation across both methods produces a valuation range of $82M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $548M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Swan's position relative to peers at this formative stage. Key variables include revenue generation and customer traction relative to the peer cohort, particularly given the $875M gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods. Near-term disclosure of revenue metrics and customer wins would materially narrow this range.
